description: List participants in your GrowSurf program, newest page first. `limit` is 1-100 (default 10). Pass response `nextId` into the next call to continue paging. Pass `metadata` to return only participants whose stored metadata matches every given key and value exactly, for example `{ "customerId": "12345" }` to look someone up by your own customer ID; filtered results are ordered by participant ID. Use this when you need a participant ID before calling participant-scoped tools. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

metadata.description: Exact-match filter on participant metadata, up to 3 keys, for example `{ "customerId": "12345" }`. Values compare as strings.

nextId.description: Participant ID returned as `nextId` from the previous page.

name: growsurf_list_participants

limit.description: Maximum number of participants requested for this page.

nextId.description: Participant id to pass as `nextId` for the next page, or `null` when there are no more results.

items.description: A participant. Shape is documented on the `growsurf_get_participant` tool.

rewardEvidence.description: What this response establishes about rewards. Combine with other reads; unknown here does not override evidence elsewhere.

approvalPolicy.description: Referral reward approval policy from requireManualRewardApproval, not affiliate commission approval or an individual reward state.

automaticFulfillmentMarking.description: The autoFulfillRewards setting, when returned by an options read. Null means unknown; this controls marking, not delivery.

title: List Participants
